name: SM_Skull_PR
dresses: human skull without the jaw, 0.16 x 0.2 x 0.2 m, facing -Y, resting on its teeth and skull base: domed cranium with zig-zag sutures, brow ridges, orbits, pear-shaped nasal aperture, cheek bones and zygomatic arches, temporal fossae, palate, eleven upper teeth (three lost); stained and pitted old bone

fit.pivot: base centre (resting on the palate), faces -Y; tip it on its side for variety

build: DINK_PP=<PhotorealPass> blender -b -t 4 --python Props/tools/props_bake.py -- <asset>; then blender -b Props/_build/Props.blend --python Props/tools/props_merge.py
status: round 2: unique bake, reviewed; not claimed photoreal where known_weaknesses lists faults
material_exception: unique bake (T_<Asset>_BC/_N/_ORM and _E where listed), private to this prop, not a row of ART_STANDARD.md section 2: the coordinator asked for sculpted or displaced high-detail sources baked to the game mesh with AO and curvature edge wear, true metal in ORM.B and emissive masks, which the shared tiling library cannot carry. Non-overlapping UV0; no vertex colour.
known_weaknesses: Round 2 unique bake from a sculpt (ellipsoid union minus cavities, voxel remesh; cached), four review rounds (r6). NOT photoreal. Last look still faults: the brain case is too large for the face (the face is about a third of the height, so it reads slightly juvenile or stylised), surfaces are smooth and clay-like between features, the zygomatic arch is a straight rod, the mastoids are knobs, orbits and nasal aperture are shallow and not dark enough inside, the teeth are separate pegs without sockets, soil staining is patchy but mild; the squamous and other minor sutures are missing. Sutures (sagittal, coronal, lambdoid), pitting, hairline cracks, lichen specks and three lost teeth are there.
